text:
deploybot: RC created: release/3.2.0 -> v3.2.0-rc1. Artifact pinned: art-3.2.0-rc1. Change window 2025-04-10 22:00-23:30 UTC. Canary target: 3% traffic in eu-west-1. Note: tokenizer vocab bump + opset bump included. Rollback commands and a short rollforward checklist attached. Please ack or raise blockers.

lucy: ack. kicking off quick staging smoke now. Will paste failures here if any.

dev_rel_jordan: heads-up: includes opset bump (PR #5120) and a small KV cache prefill tweak. Perf lab runs looked stable for 1k requests.

qa_anish: staging smoke: convo routing ok, embeddings stable for short prompts. Long prompt reranker scores shifted slightly — starting evaluation suite.

ops_rao: ops ask: schedule a 12m KV-warm after canary deploy + run prefill script. Also cap batch size to 8 in the initial canary to avoid autoscaler thundering.

oncall-sheriff: sheriff on duty for the window. Alert thresholds proposed: error-rate >1% OR p95 > baseline*2 -> pager. I'll escalate on sustained 5xx.

release-mgr: added partner note: tokenizer vocab change may reorder some near-duplicate embeddings. Marking as low risk, but will be flagged in release notes.

lucy: prepping to deploy in 2.

deploybot: Starting canary deploy -> v3.2.0-rc1 (3% eu-west-1). Jobs kicked: deploy-job-6559991234-canary. Prefill scheduled: prefill-job-6559991234.

ops_rao: prefill command (running on infra):
```
run-prefill --env prod --artifact art-3.2.0-rc1 --keys 5000 --concurrency 4 --timeout 600
```

qa_anish: canary pods up. initial metrics: error-rate 0.2%, p95 +8% (within alerting threshold). Starting eval set run.

dev_rel_jordan: confirmed rerank score drift is minor; gating tests green for semantic parity. Will keep watch on long-prompt suite.

ops_rao: after 12m warm and no regressions I'll promote to 30%. Watching OOM/GC.

deploybot: Canary -> 30% promoted (job: deploy-job-6559991234-stage2). Monitoring hooks: latency,error-rate,ooms.

lucy: saw a transient 429 burst tied to batch-size autoscale. Throttled autoscaler and capped burst. No user-facing errors reported.

oncall-sheriff: handled the alert; brief spike, resolved. No pager.

release-mgr: product approves keeping tokenizer feature flag OFF until we hit 50% and confirm partner smoke tests.

ops_rao: request approved. Deadman switch set T+10. If sustained error-rate >0.8% for 10m -> auto-rollback.

lucy: eng sign-off :white_check_mark: will wait ops deadman for full.

ops_rao: go for 100%. Rolling now.

deploybot: Promoting to 100% -> v3.2.0-rc1. Final job deploy-job-6559991234-prod. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v3.2.0-rc1

qa_anish: post-deploy quick checks running. Regressions so far: none in the smoke lanes.

dev_rel_jordan: kicking off extended regression eval in background, will file any anomalies to the release ticket.

oncall-sheriff: Observability watching: will escalate if error-rate >1% sustained. Deadman in place.

lucy: leaving tokenizer flag OFF; will schedule a controlled flip after partner smoke.

release-mgr: adding a short rollback runbook to the ticket for clarity:
- immediate: deploybot promote art-3.2.0-stable -> rollback to stable
- flip runtime flag: feature_flag:tokenizer_v3 -> false
- if rollback fails: ops to perform emergency redeploy of stable with traffic hold and DB read-only for 5m

deploybot: Deployment complete. Summary: rollout duration 27m, no automated rollback triggered, one transient 429 handled. Closing thread; tag me to reopen.
